title: Query returns unavailable when active rent exists in requested period
gherkin:
Feature: Availability Query Correctness
  Scenario: Item unavailable during active rent period
    Given an item with no existing rent records
    When a rent record is created with status Active for dates 2024-01-10 to 2024-01-20
    And an availability query is executed for the date range 2024-01-15 to 2024-01-18
    Then the query result shall indicate the item is unavailable for the requested period
rationale: Validates core availability calculation rule that items are marked unavailable when Active rent records overlap the queried date range. This is fundamental to availability query correctness.
usedContextItems: System shall return availability status indicating whether item is available or unavailable for requested period|Availability status shall reflect current lifecycle state of rent records|System shall calculate item availability based on existing rent records
